records.title: 10-K
records.text: Revenue increased 30% excluding the impact of the RUCDR alliance.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: At September 30, 2021, we had non-cancelable commitments of $65.9 million, including purchase orders for inventory of $44.0 million, information technology related commitments of $15.9 million and China facility commitments of $6.0 million related to the construction of our facility in China discussed above.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: We reported revenue of $513.7 million for fiscal year 2021 compared to $388.5 million for fiscal year 2020, an increase of $125.2 million, or 32%.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: Gross margin was 47.5% for fiscal year 2021 compared to 44.3% for fiscal year 2020, an increase in gross profit of $71.7 million.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: We reported an operating loss of $31.1 million for fiscal year 2021 compared to an operating loss of $36.6 million for fiscal year 2020, a decrease in operating loss of $5.5 million, which was primarily attributable to the revenue growth and gross margin improvement, partially offset by higher operating expenses.
